ko.title: 사우스캐롤라이나가 먼저, 아이아와는 제외: 당을 뒤흔드는 새로운 2028년 민주당 예비선거 일정을 들여다보다

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## 다음 민주당 대선 후보 선출을 위한 새로운 질서

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: 민주당 전국위원회(DNC)가 2028년 대선 후보 선출 일정을 공식 승인했으며, 핵심 변화는 놓치기 어렵습니다. 아이오와가 아닌 사우스캐롤라이나가 투표를 실시하는 첫 번째 주가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: 규칙및규정위원회(Rules and Bylaws Committee)의 수개월에 걸친 작업 끝에 DNC 전체 회의에서 최종 확정된 이번 결정은, 대선 예비선거 시즌의 전통적인 첫 경선으로서 수십 년간 지속된 아이오와의 시대에 마침표를 찍고 2024년 선거 사이클에서 조용히 시작된 재조정을 공고히 합니다.

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: 백악관 입성을 노리는 이들을 아이오와의 타운홀 미팅과 교회 지하실로 가장 먼저 보내기를 거의 반세기 동안 해온 정당에게, 이번 일정 변경은 단순한 주석 그 이상입니다.

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: 이는 다음 당의 기수를 선택할 때 어떤 유권자들이 가장 먼저 발언권을 가져야 한다고 당이 믿는지에 대한 선언입니다.

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## 2028년 일정의 모습

segments.src: According to the calendar approved by the DNC, six states will make up the party's official early window, all voting before Super Tuesday on March 7, 2028:
segments.tr: DNC가 승인한 일정에 따라, 여섯 개 주가 당의 공식적인 조기 경선 기간을 구성하며, 모두 2028년 3월 7일 슈퍼 화요일 전에 투표를 실시합니다:

segments.src: - **South Carolina** — January 22
segments.tr: - **사우스캐롤라이나** — 1월 22일

segments.src: - **Nevada** — February 1
- **New Hampshire** — February 8
segments.tr: - **뉴햄프셔** — 2월 8일

segments.src: - **New Mexico** — February 15
segments.tr: - **뉴멕시코** — 2월 15일

segments.src: - **Michigan** — February 22
- **Virginia** — February 29
segments.tr: - **버지니아** — 2월 29일

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: 이는 규칙및규정위원회가 여름 동안 그룹을 4~5개 주에서 6개 주로 확대하기로 투표하고 뉴멕시코와 버지니아를 추가한 후, 2024년 조기 경선 기간에 포함되었던 주보다 두 곳 더 많은 수치입니다.

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: DNC가 인정하는 국가의 모든 지역이 대표되며, 이는 위원회가 2025년 말 선정 절차를 시작할 때 설정한 구조적 요구사항입니다.

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## 아이오와가 최초의 주 지위를 잃은 이유

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: 아이오와가 조기 경선 라인업에서 제외된 것은 하루아침에 이루어진 일이 아닙니다.

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: 이 주의 민주당 코커스(당원대회)는 이미 2024년 최고 자리에 밀려나 있었는데, 이는 주로 2020년 혼란스러웠던 코커스 당시 결과 보고 앱 오작동으로 최종 결과가 수일간 지연되고 과정에 대한 신뢰가 훼손되었기 때문입니다.

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: 그러한 에피소드가 코커스가 예비선거보다 훨씬 적고 덜 대표성을 가진 유권자를 끌어모은다는 오랜 비판과 결합되면서, 당 지도부에게 순서를 재고할 기회를 주었습니다.

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: 사우스캐롤라이나의 부상은 당의 조기 경선 주들이 실제로 민주당을 당선시키는 연합을 더 잘 반영해야 한다는 다른 주장을 반영하며, 여기에는 과거 예비선거에서 결정적인 역할을 해온 다수의 흑인 유권자층이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: 네바다가 계속해서 조기 경선에 포함된 것은 인종 및 경제적 다양성, 그리고 강력한 노동조합 존재감에 대한 유사한 논리와 연결되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## 뉴햄프셔의 복잡한 입장

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: 뉴햄프셔는 여전히 조기 경선 기간에 남아 있지만 첫 번째는 아니며, 이는 DNC와 주 정부 간의 오랜 긴장 관계를 계속 유지시키고 있습니다.

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: 뉴햄프셔 법은 주 국무장관이 전국의 첫 번째 예비선거 일정을 잡도록 요구하고 있으며, 이는 주가 한세기 동안 시행해 온 법령입니다.

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: 그러한 법적 의무로 인해 뉴햄프셔는 2024년 당이 승인한 일정보다 앞서 승인되지 않은 예비선거를 치렀고, 이로 인해 DNC는 처벌로서 주의 대의원 자격을 박탈했습니다.

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: 2028년을 위해 이 마찰이 어떻게 해결될지 — 뉴햄프셔가 2월 8일 슬롯에 순응할지 아니면 다시 독자적으로 앞당길지 — 는 새 일정에서 가장 주목받는 부수적 사건 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## 날짜 그 이상으로 일정이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: 예비선거 일정은 결코 단순한 물류 문제가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: 가장 먼저 치러지는 것은 압도적인 언론의 주목, 모금 동력, 그리고 조기 승리를 주장할 수 있는 후보들에게 심리적 우위를 부여합니다.

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: 반대로 후순위에 있는 주들은 유권자들이 투표소에 가기도 전에 경쟁자들이 사퇴하는 것을 종종 보게 됩니다.

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: 이러한 역학 관계 때문에 일정 순서를 둘러싼 공방이 수십 년 동안 양당 모두에서 벌어졌으며, 아이오와와 뉴햄프셔에서의 조기 패배 이후 조 바이든의 2020년 선거운동을 부활시키는 데 도움을 준 사우스캐롤라이나 민주당원들이 자신들의 주를 최전선에 유지하기 위해 강력하게 밀어붙인 이유입니다.

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: 과정에 참여한 당 관료들은 이 변화를 많은 유권자와 전략가들이 구식이라고 여겼던 후보 선출 제도를 현대화하려는 노력으로 규정하는 반면, 비평가들은 이러한 개편이 특히 주들이 계속해서 자리를 다투거나 당이 승인한 순서를 무시할 경우 향후 분쟁의 여지를 여전히 많이 남겨둔다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: 투표가 시작되기 1년 이상 전에 일정이 확정됨에 따라, 2028년 예비 후보들은 이제 조기 선거운동 기반 구축, 참모 채용, 그리고 6개 조기 경선 주의 유권자 구애를 위한 더 명확한 지도를 갖추게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: 예비 후보들이 다가올 선거의 분위기를 결정할 주들에서 입지를 다지려 함에 따라, 공식 선거운동 시즌보다 훨씬 앞서 사우스캐롤라이나, 네바다, 뉴햄프셔, 뉴멕시코, 미시간, 버지니아에서 정치적 활동이 증가할 것으로 예상됩니다.

zh.title: 南卡罗来纳州领先，艾奥瓦州出局：深入了解重塑民主党的2028年总统初选新日程

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## 选择下一任民主党提名人的新秩序

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: 民主党全国委员会（DNC）已正式批准2028年总统提名日程，最引人注目的变化显而易见：南卡罗来纳州，而非艾奥瓦州，将成为第一个投票的州。

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: 这一决定由DNC全体成员在规则与章程委员会数月工作后最终敲定，为艾奥瓦州作为总统初选季传统首站的数十年历史画上了句号，并巩固了在2024年周期中悄然开始的重组。

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: 对于一个近半个世纪以来一直将白宫竞选者首先送往艾奥瓦州市政厅和教堂地下室的政党来说，这一转变不仅仅是一个日程安排上的注脚。

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: 这是一种声明，表明该党认为哪些选民应该在选择下一任旗手时拥有首要发言权。

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## 2028年日程安排概览

segments.src: According to the calendar approved by the DNC, six states will make up the party's official early window, all voting before Super Tuesday on March 7, 2028:
segments.tr: 根据DNC批准的日程，六个州将构成该党的官方早期窗口，所有投票均在2028年3月7日的“超级星期二”之前进行：

segments.src: - **South Carolina** — January 22
segments.tr: - **南卡罗来纳州** — 1月22日

segments.src: - **Nevada** — February 1
segments.tr: - **内华达州** — 2月1日

segments.src: - **New Hampshire** — February 8
segments.tr: - **新罕布什尔州** — 2月8日

segments.src: - **New Mexico** — February 15
segments.tr: - **新墨西哥州** — 2月15日

segments.src: - **Michigan** — February 22
segments.tr: - **密歇根州** — 2月22日

segments.src: - **Virginia** — February 29
segments.tr: - **弗吉尼亚州** — 2月29日

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: 这比2024年的早期窗口多了两个州。规则与章程委员会在夏季投票决定将该群体从四或五个州扩大到六个，将新墨西哥州和弗吉尼亚州纳入其中。

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: DNC认可的全国每个地区都有代表，这是委员会在2025年底开始遴选过程时设定的结构性要求。

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## 为什么艾奥瓦州失去了“全国首站”地位

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: 艾奥瓦州被移出早期阵容并非一蹴而就。

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: 该州的民主党党团会议在2024年就已经失去了首位，这主要是因为2020年党团会议的混乱，当时一个报告应用程序的故障导致最终结果延迟了数天，并削弱了人们对该程序的信心。

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: 那次事件，加上长期以来关于党团会议吸引的选民远少于初选且代表性不足的批评，给了党内领导人重新思考顺序的机会。

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: 南卡罗来纳州的崛起反映了另一种论点：该党的早期州应该更好地反映实际选举民主党人的联盟，包括在过去初选中被证明具有决定性作用的庞大黑人选民群体。

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: 内华达州继续保持早期位置也与关于种族和经济多样性的类似理由有关，此外还有其强大的工会影响力。

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## 新罕布什尔州复杂的处境

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: 新罕布什尔州仍处于早期窗口，但不再是第一，这使得DNC与该州之间长期存在的紧张关系依然存在。

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: 新罕布什尔州法律要求其州务卿安排全国首场初选，这是一项该州执行了一个世纪的法规。

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: 这一法律授权导致新罕布什尔州在2024年于该党批准的日程之前举行了一场未经批准的初选，促使DNC作为惩罚剥夺了该州的代表权。

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: 这种摩擦在2028年将如何解决——新罕布什尔州是会遵循其2月8日的时段，还是会再次自行提前——是新日程中最受关注的次要情节之一。

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## 为什么日程安排不仅仅关乎日期

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: 初选日程很少仅仅是后勤问题。

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: 率先投票能带来巨大的媒体关注、筹款势头，以及对于能够声称获得早期胜利的候选人的心理优势。

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: 相比之下，排在末尾的州往往会看到竞争者在选民前往投票站之前就退出了竞选。

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: 这种动态正是为什么关于日程顺序的争斗在两党中持续了几十年，也是为什么在艾奥瓦州和新罕布什尔州早期失利后帮助重振乔·拜登2020年竞选活动的南卡罗来纳州民主党人，一直极力推动保持其州在最前列的原因。

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: 参与该过程的党内官员将这些变化描述为旨在使许多选民和策略家认为过时的提名系统现代化，而批评者则认为这种重新洗牌仍然为未来的争议留下了充足的空间，特别是如果各州继续争夺位置或无视该党批准的顺序。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: 随着日程在投票开始前一年多就已锁定，2028年的潜在候选人现在有了更清晰的蓝图来建立早期竞选基础设施、聘请工作人员并在六个早期州争取选民。

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: 预计在正式竞选季开始前，南卡罗来纳州、内华达州、新罕布什尔州、新墨西哥州、密歇根州和弗吉尼亚州的政治活动将会增加，因为潜在的提名人试图在这些将为未来竞选定下基调的州中确立自己的地位。

hi.title: साउथ कैरोलिना सबसे पहले, आयोवा बाहर: पार्टी को हिला देने वाले नए 2028 डेमोक्रेटिक प्राइमरी कैलेंडर के अंदर की बात

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## अगले डेमोक्रेटिक उम्मीदवार को चुनने के लिए एक नई व्यवस्था

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: डेमोक्रेटिक नेशनल कमेटी ने औपचारिक रूप से 2028 के राष्ट्रपति पद के नामांकन कैलेंडर पर हस्ताक्षर कर दिए हैं, और इसमें हुआ मुख्य बदलाव नजरअंदाज करना मुश्किल है: आयोवा नहीं, बल्कि साउथ कैरोलिना मतदान करने वाला पहला राज्य होगा।

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: पूर्ण DNC द्वारा इसकी रूल्स एंड बायलॉज कमेटी के महीनों के काम के बाद अंतिम रूप दिया गया यह निर्णय, राष्ट्रपति प्राइमरी सीजन की पारंपरिक शुरुआती प्रतियोगिता के रूप में आयोवा के दशकों लंबे दौर को समाप्त करता है और उस पुनर्गठन को पुख्ता करता है जो 2024 चक्र में चुपचाप शुरू हुआ था।

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: ऐसी पार्टी के लिए जिसने लगभग आधी सदी व्हाइट हाउस के उम्मीदवारों को सबसे पहले आयोवा के टाउन हॉल और चर्च बेसमेंट में भेजा, यह बदलाव केवल एक शेड्यूलिंग फुटनोट से कहीं अधिक है।

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में एक बयान है कि पार्टी का मानना है कि उसके अगले मानक-वाहक (standard-bearer) को चुनने में किन मतदाताओं की पहली राय होनी चाहिए।

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## 2028 का कैलेंडर कैसा दिखता है

segments.src: According to the calendar approved by the DNC, six states will make up the party's official early window, all voting before Super Tuesday on March 7, 2028:
segments.tr: DNC द्वारा अनुमोदित कैलेंडर के अनुसार, छह राज्य पार्टी की आधिकारिक शुरुआती विंडो बनाएंगे, और ये सभी 7 मार्च, 2028 को सुपर ट्यूजडे से पहले मतदान करेंगे:

segments.src: - **South Carolina** — January 22
segments.tr: - **साउथ कैरोलिना** — 22 जनवरी

segments.src: - **Nevada** — February 1
- **New Hampshire** — February 8
segments.tr: - **न्यू हैम्पशायर** — 8 फरवरी

segments.src: - **New Mexico** — February 15
segments.tr: - **न्यू मैक्सिको** — 15 फरवरी

segments.src: - **Michigan** — February 22
segments.tr: - **मिशिगन** — 22 फरवरी

segments.src: - **Virginia** — February 29
segments.tr: - **वर्जीनिया** — 29 फरवरी

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: यह 2024 की शुरुआती विंडो में शामिल राज्यों से दो अधिक हैं, क्योंकि रूल्स एंड बायलॉज कमेटी ने गर्मियों में समूह को चार या पांच राज्यों से बढ़ाकर छह करने के लिए मतदान किया था, जिसमें न्यू मैक्सिको और वर्जीनिया को शामिल किया गया।

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: DNC द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त देश के हर क्षेत्र का प्रतिनिधित्व है, जो कि एक संरचनात्मक आवश्यकता है जिसे समिति ने 2025 के अंत में चयन प्रक्रिया शुरू करते समय निर्धारित किया था।

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## आयोवा ने अपना 'राष्ट्र में पहला' दर्जा क्यों खोया

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: आयोवा को शुरुआती लाइनअप से हटाना रातों-रात नहीं हुआ।

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: राज्य के डेमोक्रेटिक कॉकस को 2024 के लिए पहले ही शीर्ष स्थान से हटा दिया गया था, जिसका मुख्य कारण 2020 का अराजक कॉकस था, जब एक रिपोर्टिंग ऐप की खराबी ने अंतिम परिणामों में कई दिनों की देरी कर दी और प्रक्रिया में विश्वास को कमजोर कर दिया।

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: उस घटना ने, इस लंबे समय से चली आ रही आलोचना के साथ कि कॉकस प्राइमरी की तुलना में बहुत कम और कम प्रतिनिधि मतदाताओं को आकर्षित करते हैं, पार्टी नेताओं को क्रम पर पुनर्विचार करने का अवसर दिया।

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: साउथ कैरोलिना का उदय एक अलग तर्क को दर्शाता है: कि पार्टी के शुरुआती राज्यों को उस गठबंधन को बेहतर ढंग से प्रतिबिंबित करना चाहिए जो वास्तव में डेमोक्रेट्स को चुनता है, जिसमें बड़ी अश्वेत मतदाता आबादी शामिल है जो पिछली प्राइमरी में निर्णायक साबित हुई है।

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: नेवादा का निरंतर शुरुआती स्थान नस्लीय और आर्थिक विविधता के बारे में समान तर्क से जुड़ा है, साथ ही इसकी मजबूत यूनियन उपस्थिति भी इसका कारण है।

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## न्यू हैम्पशायर की जटिल स्थिति

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: न्यू हैम्पशायर शुरुआती विंडो में बना हुआ है, लेकिन पहले स्थान पर नहीं, जो DNC और राज्य के बीच लंबे समय से चल रहे तनाव को जीवित रखता है।

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: न्यू हैम्पशायर का कानून अपने सेक्रेटरी ऑफ स्टेट को देश की पहली प्राइमरी निर्धारित करने के लिए बाध्य करता है, एक ऐसा कानून जिसे राज्य ने एक सदी से लागू किया है।

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: उस कानूनी जनादेश के कारण न्यू हैम्पशायर ने 2024 में पार्टी के अनुमोदित कैलेंडर से पहले एक अनधिकृत प्राइमरी आयोजित की, जिसके कारण DNC ने दंड के रूप में राज्य के प्रतिनिधियों (delegates) को हटा दिया।

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: 2028 के लिए वह घर्षण कैसे सुलझता है — क्या न्यू हैम्पशायर अपने 8 फरवरी के स्लॉट के साथ सहमत होता है या फिर से अपने दम पर पहले आगे बढ़ता है — यह नए शेड्यूल के सबसे बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले उप-प्लॉट में से एक है।

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## कैलेंडर तारीखों से परे क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: प्राइमरी कैलेंडर शायद ही कभी केवल लॉजिस्टिक्स होते हैं।

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: सबसे पहले होने से मीडिया का अत्यधिक ध्यान, फंड जुटाने की गति और उन उम्मीदवारों के लिए मनोवैज्ञानिक बढ़त मिलती है जो शुरुआती जीत का दावा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, लाइन के अंत में रहने वाले राज्य अक्सर देखते हैं कि मतदाताओं के मतदान केंद्रों पर जाने से पहले ही उम्मीदवार दौड़ से बाहर हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: यही गतिशीलता कारण है कि कैलेंडर क्रम को लेकर दोनों पार्टियों में दशकों से लड़ाई छिड़ी हुई है, और यही कारण है कि साउथ कैरोलिना के डेमोक्रेट्स, जिन्होंने आयोवा और न्यू हैम्पशायर में शुरुआती हार के बाद जो बाइडन के 2020 अभियान को पुनर्जीवित करने में मदद की थी, ने अपने राज्य को सबसे आगे रखने के लिए कड़ी मेहनत की है।

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: प्रक्रिया में शामिल पार्टी अधिकारियों ने इन बदलावों को एक ऐसी नामांकन प्रणाली को आधुनिक बनाने के प्रयास के रूप में तैयार किया है जिसे कई मतदाताओं और रणनीतिकारों ने पुराना माना था, जबकि आलोचकों का तर्क है कि फेरबदल अभी भी भविष्य के विवादों के लिए काफी जगह छोड़ता है, विशेष रूप से यदि राज्य स्थिति के लिए होड़ करना जारी रखते हैं या पार्टी के अनुमोदित क्रम की अनदेखी करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: मतदान शुरू होने से एक साल से अधिक समय पहले कैलेंडर के लॉक हो जाने के साथ, संभावित 2028 के उम्मीदवारों के पास अब शुरुआती अभियान बुनियादी ढांचा बनाने, कर्मचारियों को काम पर रखने और छह शुरुआती राज्यों में मतदाताओं को लुभाने के लिए एक स्पष्ट नक्शा है।

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: औपचारिक अभियान सीजन से काफी पहले साउथ कैरोलिना, नेवादा, न्यू हैम्पशायर, न्यू मैक्सिको, मिशिगन और वर्जीनिया में बढ़ी हुई राजनीतिक गतिविधि की अपेक्षा करें, क्योंकि संभावित उम्मीदवार उन राज्यों में खुद को स्थापित करने की कोशिश करेंगे जो आने वाली दौड़ के लिए माहौल तय करेंगे।

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: La eliminación de Iowa de la alineación temprana no ocurrió de la noche a la mañana.

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: Los caucus demócratas del estado ya habían sido desplazados del primer puesto para 2024, en gran parte debido al caótico caucus de 2020, cuando un fallo en la aplicación de informes retrasó los resultados finales durante días y socavó la confianza en el proceso.

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: Ese episodio, combinado con la crítica de larga data de que los caucus atraen a muchos menos votantes y menos representativos que las primarias, dio a los líderes del partido la oportunidad de repensar el orden.

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: El ascenso de Carolina del Sur refleja un argumento diferente: que los estados tempranos del partido deberían reflejar mejor la coalición que realmente elige a los demócratas, incluido el gran electorado negro que ha demostrado ser decisivo en primarias pasadas.

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: La continua ubicación temprana de Nevada está vinculada a un razonamiento similar sobre la diversidad racial y económica, junto con su fuerte presencia sindical.

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## La complicada posición de Nuevo Hampshire

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: Nuevo Hampshire permanece en la ventana temprana, pero no primero, lo que mantiene viva una tensión de larga duración entre el DNC y el estado.

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: La ley de Nuevo Hampshire exige que su secretario de estado programe la primera primaria de la nación, un estatuto que el estado ha hecho cumplir durante un siglo.

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: Ese mandato legal llevó a Nuevo Hampshire a celebrar una primaria no sancionada antes del calendario aprobado por el partido en 2024, lo que provocó que el DNC despojara al estado de delegados como penalización.

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: Cómo se resuelva esa fricción para 2028 —si Nuevo Hampshire se alinea con su espacio del 8 de febrero o vuelve a adelantarse por su cuenta— es una de las subtramas más observadas del nuevo calendario.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## Por qué el calendario importa más allá de las fechas

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: Los calendarios de primarias rara vez son solo logística.

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: Ir primero confiere una atención mediática desmedida, impulso en la recaudación de fondos y una ventaja psicológica para los candidatos que pueden reclamar una victoria temprana.

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: Los estados al final de la fila, por el contrario, a menudo ven cómo los contendientes abandonan antes de que los votantes siquiera acudan a las urnas.

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: Esa dinámica es la razón por la que las peleas por el orden del calendario han estallado en ambos partidos durante décadas, y por la que los demócratas de Carolina del Sur, que ayudaron a revivir la campaña de Joe Biden en 2020 después de las primeras derrotas en Iowa y Nuevo Hampshire, han presionado mucho para mantener a su estado al frente.

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios del partido involucrados en el proceso han enmarcado los cambios como un esfuerzo para modernizar un sistema de nominación que muchos votantes y estrategas consideraban obsoleto, mientras que los críticos argumentan que la reorganización aún deja mucho espacio para futuras disputas, particularmente si los estados continúan compitiendo por la posición o ignorando el orden aprobado por el partido.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: Con el calendario fijado más de un año antes de que comience la votación, los posibles candidatos de 2028 ahora tienen un mapa más claro para construir una infraestructura de campaña temprana, contratar personal y cortejar a los votantes en los seis estados tempranos.

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: Se espera una mayor actividad política en Carolina del Sur, Nevada, Nuevo Hampshire, Nuevo México, Míchigan y Virginia mucho antes de la temporada formal de campaña, a medida que los aspirantes a la nominación intenten establecerse en los estados que marcarán la pauta para la carrera que se avecina.

ar.title: ساوث كارولينا أولاً، أيوا خارج السباق: نظرة على تقويم الانتخابات التمهيدية الديمقراطية الجديد لعام 2028 الذي يهز الحزب

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## نظام جديد لاختيار المرشح الديمقراطي القادم

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: وافقت اللجنة الوطنية الديمقراطية رسمياً على تقويم الانتخابات التمهيدية الرئاسية لعام 2028، والتغيير الرئيسي لا يمكن تفويته: ساوث كارولينا، وليس أيوا، ستكون أول ولاية تصوت.

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: هذا القرار، الذي وضعته اللجنة الوطنية الديمقراطية بالكامل بعد أشهر من العمل من قبل لجنة القواعد واللوائح الداخلية، يطوي صفحة عقود من الزمن كانت فيها أيوا هي الولاية الافتتاحية التقليدية لموسم الانتخابات التمهيدية الرئاسية، ويكرس إعادة تنظيم بدأت بهدوء في دورة عام 2024.

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لحزب أمضى ما يقرب من نصف قرن في إرسال الطامحين للبيت الأبيض أولاً إلى قاعات البلدية وأقبية الكنائس في أيوا، فإن هذا التحول هو أكثر من مجرد ملاحظة هامشية في الجدول الزمني.

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: إنه بيان حول الناخبين الذين يعتقد الحزب أنه يجب أن يكون لهم القول الفصل في اختيار حامل لوائه القادم.

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## كيف يبدو تقويم عام 2028

segments.tr: - **نيفادا** — 1 فبراير

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: هذا يزيد بولايتين عما كان عليه الحال في النافذة المبكرة لعام 2024، بعد أن صوتت لجنة القواعد واللوائح الداخلية خلال الصيف لتوسيع المجموعة من أربع أو خمس ولايات إلى ست، بإضافة نيومكسيكو وفيرجينيا إلى المزيج.

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: يتم تمثيل كل منطقة من مناطق البلاد التي تعترف بها اللجنة الوطنية الديمقراطية، وهو مطلب هيكلي وضعته اللجنة عندما بدأت عملية الاختيار في أواخر عام 2025.

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## لماذا فقدت أيوا مكانتها كأول ولاية في البلاد

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: لم يحدث استبعاد أيوا من التشكيلة المبكرة بين عشية وضحاها.

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: كانت المجالس الانتخابية الديمقراطية في الولاية قد أُبعدت بالفعل عن المركز الأول لعام 2024، ويرجع ذلك إلى حد كبير إلى الفوضى التي شهدتها مجالس عام 2020، عندما أدى عطل في تطبيق الإبلاغ إلى تأخير النتائج النهائية لأيام وتقويض الثقة في العملية.

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: تلك الحلقة، إلى جانب الانتقادات طويلة الأمد بأن المجالس الانتخابية تجذب عدداً أقل بكثير من الناخبين وأقل تمثيلاً من الانتخابات التمهيدية، منحت قادة الحزب الفرصة لإعادة التفكير في الترتيب.

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: يعكس صعود ساوث كارولينا حجة مختلفة: وهي أن الولايات المبكرة للحزب يجب أن تعكس بشكل أفضل التحالف الذي ينتخب الديمقراطيين بالفعل، بما في ذلك الناخبون السود الذين أثبتوا أنهم حاسمون في الانتخابات التمهيدية السابقة.

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: يرتبط استمرار نيفادا في الترتيب المبكر بتفكير مماثل حول التنوع العرقي والاقتصادي، إلى جانب وجودها النقابي القوي.

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## وضع نيوهامبشير المعقد

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: تظل نيوهامبشير في النافذة المبكرة، ولكن ليس في المركز الأول، مما يبقي على توتر طويل الأمد بين اللجنة الوطنية الديمقراطية والولاية.

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: يتطلب قانون نيوهامبشير من وزير خارجيتها تحديد موعد أول انتخابات تمهيدية في البلاد، وهو قانون طبقته الولاية منذ قرن من الزمان.

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: أدى هذا التفويض القانوني إلى قيام نيوهامبشير بإجراء انتخابات تمهيدية غير مصرح بها قبل التقويم المعتمد للحزب في عام 2024، مما دفع اللجنة الوطنية الديمقراطية إلى تجريد الولاية من المندوبين كعقوبة.

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: كيف سيتم حل هذا الاحتكاك لعام 2028 - سواء التزمت نيوهامبشير بفتحة 8 فبراير أو تحركت مرة أخرى في وقت أبكر من تلقاء نفسها - هو أحد الحبكات الفرعية التي تتم مراقبتها عن كثب في الجدول الزمني الجديد.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم التقويم أبعد من مجرد التواريخ

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: صاغ مسؤولو الحزب المشاركون في العملية التغييرات كجهد لتحديث نظام ترشيح اعتبره العديد من الناخبين والاستراتيجيين عفا عليه الزمن، بينما يجادل النقاد بأن إعادة الترتيب لا تزال تترك مجالاً كبيراً للنزاعات المستقبلية، خاصة إذا استمرت الولايات في التنافس على المراكز أو تجاهلت الترتيب المعتمد من الحزب.

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: Ce mandat légal a conduit le New Hampshire à organiser une primaire non autorisée avant le calendrier approuvé par le parti en 2024, ce qui a incité le DNC à retirer ses délégués à l'État en guise de sanction.

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: La manière dont cette friction se résoudra pour 2028 — si le New Hampshire se conforme à son créneau du 8 février ou s'il avance à nouveau la date de son propre chef — est l'une des intrigues les plus suivies du nouveau calendrier.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le calendrier compte au-delà des dates

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: Les États situés en fin de liste, en revanche, voient souvent les candidats abandonner avant même que les électeurs ne se rendent aux urnes.

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## Uma Nova Ordem para Escolher o Próximo Candidato Democrata

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: O Comitê Nacional Democrata aprovou formalmente o calendário das primárias presidenciais para 2028, e a principal mudança é difícil de ignorar: a Carolina do Sul, e não Iowa, será o primeiro estado a votar.

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: A decisão, finalizada pelo DNC após meses de trabalho do seu Comitê de Regras e Estatutos, encerra o capítulo da longa trajetória de Iowa como o tradicional concurso de abertura da temporada das primárias presidenciais e consolida um realinhamento que começou discretamente no ciclo de 2024.

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: Para um partido que passou quase meio século enviando os aspirantes à Casa Branca primeiro para as assembleias e porões de igrejas de Iowa, a mudança é mais do que uma nota de rodapé no cronograma.

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: É uma declaração sobre quais eleitores o partido acredita que devem ter a primeira palavra na escolha do seu próximo porta-estandarte.

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## Como é o Calendário de 2028

segments.src: According to the calendar approved by the DNC, six states will make up the party's official early window, all voting before Super Tuesday on March 7, 2028:
segments.tr: De acordo com o calendário aprovado pelo DNC, seis estados comporão a janela inicial oficial do partido, todos votando antes da Super Terça-feira, em 7 de março de 2028:

segments.tr: - **Carolina do Sul** — 22 de janeiro

segments.src: - **Nevada** — February 1
segments.tr: - **Nevada** — 1º de fevereiro

segments.tr: Isso representa dois estados a mais do que na janela inicial de 2024, depois que o Comitê de Regras e Estatutos votou durante o verão para expandir o grupo de quatro ou cinco estados para seis, adicionando o Novo México e a Virgínia à mistura.

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: Todas as regiões do país reconhecidas pelo DNC estão representadas, um requisito estrutural que o comitê estabeleceu quando iniciou o processo de seleção no final de 2025.

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## Por que Iowa Perdeu seu Status de Primeiro da Nação

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: A remoção de Iowa da lista inicial não aconteceu da noite para o dia.

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: Os caucus democratas do estado já haviam sido retirados do primeiro lugar em 2024, em grande parte devido ao caótico caucus de 2020, quando uma falha em um aplicativo de relatório atrasou os resultados finais por dias e minou a confiança no processo.

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: Esse episódio, combinado com críticas de longa data de que os caucus atraem muito menos eleitores e eleitores menos representativos do que as primárias, deu aos líderes do partido a oportunidade de repensar a ordem.

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: A ascensão da Carolina do Sul reflete um argumento diferente: que os estados iniciais do partido devem refletir melhor a coalizão que realmente elege os Democratas, incluindo o grande eleitorado negro que provou ser decisivo em primárias anteriores.

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: A permanência de Nevada no início do calendário está ligada a um raciocínio semelhante sobre diversidade racial e econômica, juntamente com sua forte presença sindical.

segments.tr: 半世紀近くにわたり、ホワイトハウスを目指す候補者たちをまずアイオワ州のタウンホールや教会の地下室へと送り出してきた党にとって、この変更は単なるスケジュールの注釈以上の意味を持つ。

segments.src: It is a statement about which voters the party believes should have the first say in picking its next standard-bearer.
segments.tr: これは、党の次期代表を選ぶ際に、どの有権者が最初に発言権を持つべきかという党の姿勢を示すものだ。

segments.src: ## What the 2028 Calendar Looks Like
segments.tr: ## 2028年カレンダーの全容

segments.src: According to the calendar approved by the DNC, six states will make up the party's official early window, all voting before Super Tuesday on March 7, 2028:
segments.tr: DNCが承認したカレンダーによると、2028年3月7日のスーパーチューズデーより前に投票を行う党の公式な早期投票州は以下の6州となる。

segments.src: - **South Carolina** — January 22
segments.tr: - **サウスカロライナ州** — 1月22日

segments.src: - **Nevada** — February 1
segments.tr: - **ネバダ州** — 2月1日

segments.src: - **New Hampshire** — February 8
segments.tr: - **ニューハンプシャー州** — 2月8日

segments.src: - **New Mexico** — February 15
segments.tr: - **ニューメキシコ州** — 2月15日

segments.src: - **Michigan** — February 22
segments.tr: - **ミシガン州** — 2月22日

segments.src: - **Virginia** — February 29
segments.tr: - **バージニア州** — 2月29日

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: これは2024年の早期投票州より2州多い。規則・規約委員会が夏に投票を行い、対象を4〜5州から6州へと拡大し、ニューメキシコ州とバージニア州を加えたためだ。

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: DNCが認める国内の全地域が代表されており、これは2025年後半に選定プロセスを開始した際に委員会が設定した構造上の要件である。

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## なぜアイオワ州は全米初の地位を失ったのか

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: アイオワ州が早期投票のラインナップから外れたのは、一夜にして起きたことではない。

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: 同州の民主党党員集会（コーカス）は、2024年にはすでにトップの座から押し出されていた。その主な理由は、2020年の党員集会での混乱である。集計アプリの不具合により最終結果の発表が数日間遅れ、プロセスへの信頼が損なわれたためだ。

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: その出来事に加え、党員集会は予備選に比べて参加者がはるかに少なく、代表性に欠けるという長年の批判が重なり、党指導部が順序を見直すきっかけとなった。

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: サウスカロライナ州の台頭は、異なる議論を反映している。つまり、党の早期投票州は、過去の予備選で決定的な役割を果たしてきた大規模な黒人有権者層を含め、実際に民主党を当選させる連合をよりよく反映すべきだという考えだ。

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: ネバダ州が引き続き早期投票州に含まれているのは、人種的・経済的多様性、そして強力な労働組合の存在という同様の理由に基づいている。

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## ニューハンプシャー州の複雑な立場

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: ニューハンプシャー州は早期投票枠に残ったものの、最初ではなくなった。これにより、DNCと同州との間の長年の緊張関係が続いている。

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: ニューハンプシャー州法は州務長官に対し、全米初の予備選をスケジュールするよう義務付けており、同州はこの法律を1世紀にわたって施行してきた。

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: この法的義務により、ニューハンプシャー州は2024年に党が承認したカレンダーよりも前に非公認の予備選を実施し、その結果、DNCは罰則として同州の代議員資格を剥奪した。

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: この摩擦が2028年に向けてどのように解決されるか、つまりニューハンプシャー州が2月8日の枠に従うのか、それとも再び独自に前倒しするのかは、新しいスケジュールのなかでも特に注目されているサブプロットの一つである。

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## なぜカレンダーは日程以上の意味を持つのか

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: 予備選のカレンダーは、単なるロジスティクスの問題ではない。

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: 最初に投票を行うことは、メディアの注目を過剰に集め、資金調達の勢いをつけ、早期勝利を主張できる候補者に心理的な優位性を与える。

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: 対照的に、スケジュールの後ろの方に位置する州では、有権者が投票所に行く前に候補者が撤退してしまうことがよくある。

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: こうした力学があるからこそ、カレンダーの順序をめぐる争いは何十年にもわたって両党で激化してきたのであり、アイオワとニューハンプシャーでの初期の敗北後にジョー・バイデンの2020年キャンペーンを復活させたサウスカロライナ州の民主党員たちが、自州を先頭に維持しようと強く働きかけてきたのである。

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: このプロセスに関与した党関係者は、今回の変更を、多くの有権者や戦略家が時代遅れとみなしていた指名システムを近代化するための取り組みであると説明している。一方で批判者は、この再編によって将来的な紛争の余地は依然として残されており、特に各州が順位を競い続けたり、党が承認した順序を無視したりすれば、再び問題が起こるだろうと主張している。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: 投票開始まで1年以上を残してカレンダーが確定したことで、2028年の候補予定者は、早期の選挙運動インフラの構築、スタッフの雇用、そして6つの早期投票州での有権者への働きかけに向けた、より明確な地図を手に入れたことになる。

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: 正式な選挙戦シーズンが始まるずっと前から、サウスカロライナ、ネバダ、ニューハンプシャー、ニューメキシコ、ミシガン、バージニアの各州では政治活動が活発化するだろう。指名候補を目指す者たちが、今後のレースの基調を決定づけるこれらの州で、自らの地盤を固めようとするからだ。

segments.src: ## A New Order for Choosing the Next Democratic Nominee
segments.tr: ## Eine neue Reihenfolge für die Kür des nächsten demokratischen Nominierten

segments.src: The Democratic National Committee has formally signed off on the presidential nominating calendar for 2028, and the headline change is hard to miss: South Carolina, not Iowa, will be the first state to vote.
segments.tr: Das Democratic National Committee hat den Nominierungskalender für die Präsidentschaftswahl 2028 offiziell abgesegnet, und die wichtigste Änderung ist kaum zu übersehen: Nicht Iowa, sondern South Carolina wird der erste Bundesstaat sein, der wählt.

segments.src: The decision, finalized by the full DNC after months of work by its Rules and Bylaws Committee, closes the book on Iowa's decades-long run as the traditional opening contest of presidential primary season and cements a realignment that began quietly in the 2024 cycle.
segments.tr: Die Entscheidung, die vom gesamten DNC nach monatelanger Arbeit seines Ausschusses für Regeln und Satzungen (Rules and Bylaws Committee) finalisiert wurde, beendet Iowas jahrzehntelange Ära als traditioneller Auftaktwettbewerb der Vorwahlsaison und zementiert eine Neuausrichtung, die im Wahlzyklus 2024 leise begann.

segments.src: For a party that spent nearly half a century sending White House hopefuls first to Iowa's town halls and church basements, the shift is more than a scheduling footnote.
segments.tr: Für eine Partei, die fast ein halbes Jahrhundert lang Präsidentschaftsanwärter zuerst zu Iowas Bürgerversammlungen (Town Halls) und in Kellersäle von Kirchen geschickt hat, ist dieser Wechsel mehr als nur eine Fußnote im Terminkalender.

segments.tr: Er ist ein Statement darüber, welche Wähler nach Ansicht der Partei als Erste bei der Kür ihres nächsten Spitzenkandidaten Mitspracherecht haben sollten.

segments.src: That is two more states than were in the early window for 2024, after the Rules and Bylaws Committee voted over the summer to expand the group from four or five states to six, adding New Mexico and Virginia to the mix.
segments.tr: Đó là nhiều hơn hai bang so với cửa sổ bầu cử sớm năm 2024, sau khi Ủy ban Quy tắc và Điều lệ bỏ phiếu vào mùa hè để mở rộng nhóm từ bốn hoặc năm bang lên sáu, thêm New Mexico và Virginia vào danh sách.

segments.src: Every region of the country recognized by the DNC is represented, a structural requirement the committee set out when it began the selection process in late 2025.
segments.tr: Mọi khu vực của đất nước được DNC công nhận đều có đại diện, một yêu cầu về cấu trúc mà ủy ban đã đặt ra khi bắt đầu quá trình lựa chọn vào cuối năm 2025.

segments.src: ## Why Iowa Lost Its First-in-the-Nation Status
segments.tr: ## Tại sao Iowa mất vị thế là bang đầu tiên trên toàn quốc

segments.src: Iowa's removal from the early lineup did not happen overnight.
segments.tr: Việc loại Iowa khỏi danh sách bầu cử sớm không xảy ra trong một sớm một chiều.

segments.src: The state's Democratic caucuses had already been pushed out of the top spot for 2024, largely because of the chaotic 2020 caucus, when a reporting app malfunction delayed final results for days and undermined confidence in the process.
segments.tr: Các cuộc họp kín (caucus) của Đảng Dân chủ tại bang này đã bị đẩy khỏi vị trí dẫn đầu cho năm 2024, phần lớn là do cuộc họp kín hỗn loạn năm 2020, khi một ứng dụng báo cáo gặp trục trặc đã làm chậm kết quả cuối cùng trong nhiều ngày và làm suy giảm niềm tin vào quy trình.

segments.src: That episode, combined with long-standing criticism that caucuses draw far fewer and less representative voters than primaries, gave party leaders the opening to rethink the order.
segments.tr: Tập phim đó, kết hợp với những chỉ trích lâu nay rằng các cuộc họp kín thu hút ít cử tri hơn và ít đại diện hơn so với các cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ, đã tạo cơ hội cho các nhà lãnh đạo đảng suy nghĩ lại về thứ tự.

segments.src: South Carolina's rise reflects a different argument: that the party's early states should better reflect the coalition that actually elects Democrats, including the large Black electorate that has proven decisive in past primaries.
segments.tr: Sự trỗi dậy của South Carolina phản ánh một lập luận khác: rằng các bang bầu cử sớm của đảng nên phản ánh tốt hơn liên minh thực sự bầu ra các đảng viên Dân chủ, bao gồm cả cử tri người da đen đông đảo đã chứng tỏ là yếu tố quyết định trong các cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ trước đây.

segments.src: Nevada's continued early placement is tied to similar reasoning about racial and economic diversity, along with its strong union presence.
segments.tr: Việc Nevada tiếp tục được xếp ở vị trí sớm gắn liền với lý do tương tự về sự đa dạng chủng tộc và kinh tế, cùng với sự hiện diện mạnh mẽ của công đoàn tại đây.

segments.src: ## New Hampshire's Complicated Position
segments.tr: ## Vị thế phức tạp của New Hampshire

segments.src: New Hampshire remains in the early window, but not first, which keeps alive a long-running tension between the DNC and the state.
segments.tr: New Hampshire vẫn nằm trong cửa sổ bầu cử sớm, nhưng không phải là đầu tiên, điều này duy trì sự căng thẳng kéo dài giữa DNC và bang này.

segments.src: New Hampshire law requires its secretary of state to schedule the nation's first primary, a statute the state has enforced for a century.
segments.tr: Luật của New Hampshire yêu cầu thư ký bang phải lên lịch cho cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ đầu tiên của quốc gia, một đạo luật mà bang đã thực thi trong một thế kỷ.

segments.src: That legal mandate led New Hampshire to hold an unsanctioned primary ahead of the party's approved calendar in 2024, prompting the DNC to strip the state of delegates as a penalty.
segments.tr: Ủy nhiệm pháp lý đó đã khiến New Hampshire tổ chức một cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ không được phê duyệt trước lịch trình của đảng vào năm 2024, khiến DNC tước quyền đại biểu của bang này như một hình phạt.

segments.src: How that friction resolves for 2028 — whether New Hampshire falls in line with its February 8 slot or again moves earlier on its own — is one of the more closely watched subplots of the new schedule.
segments.tr: Cách mà sự ma sát đó được giải quyết cho năm 2028 — liệu New Hampshire có tuân thủ lịch trình ngày 8 tháng 2 hay lại tự mình chuyển lên sớm hơn — là một trong những tình tiết phụ được theo dõi chặt chẽ nhất của lịch trình mới.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Matters Beyond the Dates
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lịch trình lại quan trọng ngoài các ngày tháng

segments.src: Primary calendars are rarely just logistics.
segments.tr: Lịch bầu cử sơ bộ hiếm khi chỉ là vấn đề hậu cần.

segments.src: Going first confers outsized media attention, fundraising momentum and a psychological edge for candidates who can claim an early win.
segments.tr: Việc đi đầu mang lại sự chú ý lớn từ truyền thông, đà gây quỹ và lợi thế tâm lý cho các ứng viên có thể tuyên bố chiến thắng sớm.

segments.src: States near the back of the line, by contrast, often see contenders drop out before voters even head to the polls.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, các bang ở cuối danh sách thường thấy các ứng viên bỏ cuộc trước khi cử tri kịp đi bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: That dynamic is why fights over calendar order have flared in both parties for decades, and why South Carolina Democrats, who helped revive Joe Biden's 2020 campaign after early losses in Iowa and New Hampshire, have pushed hard to keep their state at the front.
segments.tr: Động lực đó là lý do tại sao các cuộc chiến về thứ tự lịch trình đã bùng phát ở cả hai đảng trong nhiều thập kỷ, và tại sao các đảng viên Dân chủ ở South Carolina, những người đã giúp hồi sinh chiến dịch năm 2020 của Joe Biden sau những thất bại sớm ở Iowa và New Hampshire, đã thúc đẩy mạnh mẽ để giữ bang của họ ở vị trí đầu tiên.

segments.src: Party officials involved in the process have framed the changes as an effort to modernize a nominating system that many voters and strategists viewed as outdated, while critics argue the reshuffling still leaves plenty of room for future disputes, particularly if states continue to jockey for position or ignore the party's approved order.
segments.tr: Các quan chức đảng tham gia vào quá trình này đã coi những thay đổi này là một nỗ lực nhằm hiện đại hóa hệ thống đề cử mà nhiều cử tri và chiến lược gia coi là lỗi thời, trong khi những người chỉ trích lập luận rằng việc xáo trộn vẫn để lại nhiều chỗ cho các tranh chấp trong tương lai, đặc biệt nếu các bang tiếp tục tranh giành vị trí hoặc phớt lờ thứ tự đã được đảng phê duyệt.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: With the calendar locked in more than a year before voting begins, prospective 2028 candidates now have a clearer map for building early campaign infrastructure, hiring staff and courting voters in the six early states.
segments.tr: Với lịch trình được chốt hơn một năm trước khi bỏ phiếu bắt đầu, các ứng viên tiềm năng năm 2028 hiện có một bản đồ rõ ràng hơn để xây dựng cơ sở hạ tầng chiến dịch sớm, thuê nhân viên và vận động cử tri tại sáu bang bầu cử sớm.

segments.src: Expect increased political activity in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia well ahead of the formal campaign season, as would-be nominees try to establish themselves in the states that will set the tone for the race to come.
segments.tr: Hãy mong đợi hoạt động chính trị gia tăng ở South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan và Virginia trước mùa chiến dịch chính thức, khi các ứng viên tiềm năng cố gắng khẳng định vị thế của mình tại các bang sẽ tạo ra tông màu cho cuộc đua sắp tới.
